verdict.rationale: Gladia's pre-recorded quickstart lists speaker diarization as a requestable feature that separates the speakers across the conversation. This covers the core of requesting diarization and getting speaker-attributed output. The evidence is a single brief line, though. missing for 10: documented request parameter and output schema showing per-utterance speaker labels, diarization tuning (e.g., expected speaker count), live/real-time diarization support, independent or hands-on corroboration of labeling accuracy.

support.subject: As a developer, I can request speaker diarization and the transcript labels who said what

citations.quote: Speaker diarization: separate the speakers across the conversation
